title: Jev live per-field decisions in expect form steps
description: jev_shadow.py gains --task-doc field decisions: Jev picks a value per field, acts when its confidence clears a floor and defers to the incumbent below it, logging jev_pick, jev_confidence, incumbent_pick, agree, floor, decided_by, prompt_id and session_id for every decision. The page replays 240 sealed checks from ten fresh-session runs and lets you move the confidence floor to see which fields Jev would have decided and which it would have handed back.
